name: kitsu
description: Coordinate coding tasks across Codex and Claude Code. Configure each specialist's host, model and reasoning, resume saved tasks, and keep verification evidence with the worktree.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate coding roles and verify their work
interface.longDescription: Start or resume a task in either coding host. Use the configured workflow to choose the host, model and reasoning for each specialist. Kitsu saves the task's scope, assignments, checks and review evidence in the worktree. An optional Git gate checks evidence before commits and pushes.
